Who are we? 
 Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.   

 
 
A place where tech thinkers and future builders turn bold ideas into breakthrough experiences, we welcome your unique perspective. 
 
Help us challenge assumptions, uncover bias, and remove barriers—because progress starts with fresh ideas. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work. 
 
 Job Summary 
 Keeps Equinix's GenAI products and platforms stable and reliable, and makes them more resilient over time. Writes the code and automation that prevents failures, rather than only responding to them. Defines service-level objectives, builds monitoring and alerting, hardens services against dependency and capacity failures, and tests failure and recovery before they happen in production. Leads incident response when issues occur and turns each incident into a lasting fix. Works in a team with senior engineers and with product, platform and security partners to keep AI products, agents, connectors and self-hosted models robust, secure, observable and performant.


 Knowledge and Application
 Applies solid knowledge of software engineering and site reliability engineering (SRE) practice: service-level objectives (SLOs), error budgets, monitoring, alerting, incident response, CI/CD and infrastructure as code. Understands how distributed systems fail and how to contain those failures (timeouts, retries, circuit breakers, graceful degradation). Understands how GenAI products behave in production, including model latency, rate limits, quotas, streaming and token cost. Follows established standards and suggests improvements.

 Complexity and Problem Solving
 Works on problems of defined scope where analysis requires evaluation of identifiable factors. Diagnoses failures across application, model, data, pipeline and infrastructure layers, and fixes the underlying cause rather than the symptom. Applies existing runbooks and approaches, and improves them. Escalates unusual or high-impact issues. Work is reviewed at defined checkpoints.

 Collaboration and Interaction
 Works with AI engineers, product managers, platform and security teams. Reviews designs and releases for reliability risk before they ship. Explains status, incidents and results clearly to partners who are not familiar with the subject. Asks for guidance early and shares knowledge with the team.

 Responsibilities 
 Reliability and resilience engineering (primary focus)
 Write code and automation that makes GenAI products and platforms more resilient: retries, timeouts, circuit breakers, rate limiting, graceful degradation and fallback between models and providers
 Run load tests, failure-injection tests and game days to find weak points before users do, and fix what they reveal
 Harden services running on Kubernetes: health checks, autoscaling, disruption budgets, resource limits and multi-zone deployment
 Plan capacity ahead of launches and growth, including model-provider quotas, GPU and inference capacity, and database headroom
 Maintain backup, restore and disaster-recovery plans, and test recovery on a regular schedule
 Automate repeated operational tasks, and reduce manual work each quarter
 
 Monitoring and service levels
 Define and track service-level indicators and objectives with product owners: availability, latency, error rate, token cost and quality scores
 Instrument services with logs, metrics and traces (e.g., OpenTelemetry), from the user request through agent, tool and model calls
 Build and tune dashboards and alerts for user-facing failures, and remove alerts that are noisy or not actionable
 
 Release and deployment
 Support release readiness for GenAI products and platforms: checks for monitoring, alerts, runbooks, capacity, security review and rollback plan
 Deploy through CI/CD and GitOps pipelines, using containers and infrastructure as code, with canary rollouts and fast rollback
 
 Incident response
 Take part in the on-call rotation, respond to incidents, and write blameless post-incident reviews
 Track post-incident actions to completion, so the same failure does not happen twice
 Write and update runbooks, and turn recurring incidents into automation or fixes
 
 GenAI and self-hosted models
 Support the reliability of self-hosted open-weight and small language models: serving, GPU usage, scaling, rollout and rollback
 Monitor model and provider latency, errors, rate limits and cost, and flag capacity and cost risks
 Apply security, patching, secrets and data-boundary requirements to every deployment
 
 Qualifications 
 Required
 1–4 years in site reliability, DevOps, platform or software engineering, with hands-on work on production systems
 Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience
 Proficiency in Python or Go, with solid software engineering habits: version control, testing, code review
 Experience with Linux, containers, Kubernetes and a major cloud platform (Google Cloud preferred)
 Experience with CI/CD and infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform)
 Working knowledge of monitoring, logging, tracing and alerting
 Understanding of how distributed systems fail and of common resilience patterns
 Experience with on-call or incident response, and willingness to join an on-call rotation
 Familiarity with LLM applications (model APIs, retrieval, agents, tool calls)
 Clear written and verbal communication
 
 Nice to have
 Experience running GenAI or ML systems in production, including managed model platforms (e.g., Vertex AI) or model serving (e.g., vLLM)
 Experience with observability tools (e.g., OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana) and incident tools (e.g., PagerDuty)
 Experience with GitOps (e.g., Argo CD), Helm and canary deployments
 Experience with load testing or chaos engineering
 Experience with secrets management (e.g., Vault) and security scanning
 Experience building automation or AI agents that reduce operational work
 
 What success looks like
 GenAI products and platforms meet their service-level objectives, and releases ship without avoidable incidents
 Alerts catch failures before users report them, and each incident ends with a documented fix
 The same incident does not happen twice
 Load tests and recovery tests run on schedule, and launches scale without capacity issues
 Manual operational work goes down each quarter
 The engineer takes on larger, less defined work each quarter with decreasing guidance

 Equinix Benefits 
 As an employee, you become important to Equinix’s success. We ensure all your benefits are in line with our core values: competitive, inclusive, sustainable, connected and efficient. We keep them competitive within the current marketplace to ensure we’re providing you with the best package possible. So, wherever you are in your career and life, you’ll be able to enhance your experience and bring your whole self to work.
 
 Employee Assistance Program : An Employee Assistance program is available to all employees.

US Benefits: - Insurance: You may enroll in health, life, disability and voluntary plans that are designed for you and your eligible family members. - Retirement: You and Equinix may contribute to a retirement plan to help you plan for your financial future. - Paid Time Off (PTO) and Paid Holidays: You will receive an accrued amount of PTO each pay period along with various paid holidays for you to rest and recharge. Eligibility requirements apply to some benefits. Benefits are subject to change and may be subject to specific plan or program terms.

Canada Core Benefits: - Insurance: You may enroll in healthcare coverage that is designed to complement the provincial healthcare system, along with life, disability and optional benefit plans that are designed for you and your eligible family members. - Retirement: You may also enroll in Equinix-sponsored retirement or savings plans: Defined Contribution Pension Plan (DCPP), Group Retirement Savings Plan (RRSP) and Tax-Free Savings Plan (TSFA). - Vacation and Paid Holidays: Equinix offers both vacation and personal time, along with various paid holidays for you to rest and recharge. Eligibility requirements apply to some benefits. Benefits are subject to specific plan or program terms, and to change at Equinix discretion.
